note: Phase 5 fixed test set — also the deciphering report set. Classes measured through the real standalone pipeline (probe-testset) from the dev sandbox on 2026-11-06. Datacenter IPs are bot-gated for anonymous player calls (LOGIN_REQUIRED after the first requests), so fresh standalone extraction mostly degrades to the honest embed fallback THERE; on residential IPs (device) the same ids extract directly. The e2e-ads suite asserts per-video: playable ones carry only googlevideo/byte-proxy media, embed-mode ones show the honest notice.

baseline_2026_11_06.standalone_from_datacenter: 28/29 embed-fallback (97%) — dominated by IP-level LOGIN_REQUIRED gating of anonymous player calls, NOT by signatureCipher; deciphering cannot move this number from a datacenter IP
baseline_2026_11_06.server_mode_fresh_ids: gated the same way once the IP's quota is spent (cached ids still extract: e.g. dQw4w9WgXcQ, 2160p ladder intact)
baseline_2026_11_06.device_expectation: on a residential IP the anonymous ANDROID_VR client returns direct URLs for most videos (probed earlier today: 27 direct formats for the first video incl. 2160p), and ciphered WEB/TV responses are exactly what yt-decipher exists for — the -10pp embed-fallback reduction is therefore a DEVICE checklist proof, recorded as such per plan risk #6
